title: That 'hit by a truck' feeling? It's sleep inertia.
caption:
Why does waking up feel like a truck hit you?
Our guy sleeps like a baby, then the alarm jolts him awake: wide bleary eyes, head in hands, and a hologram chart of deep sleep crashing into awakeness.
It's sleep inertia - an alarm yanks you out of deep sleep, so your body is awake while your brain is still rebooting through the fog.
How many minutes does your brain take to boot up each morning?
Save this for your next alarm and follow for more body-science explainers.
